3.1.value: CADENCE: DAILY - stockholders may request repurchase of all or part of their shares any day at that day's NAV per share (plan first announced 2011; contrast monthly/quarterly windows at BREIT/SREIT). CAP: 5% of the combined NAV of all classes per calendar quarter (~20% of total NAV per printed 12-month arithmetic). BASE: combined NAV of all share classes as of the last day of the previous calendar quarter. MECHANISM: issuer share repurchase plan (not '40-Act tenders); company is not obligated to repurchase and board may modify or suspend at any time; one-year holding period with death/disability/key-person exceptions and DRIP exemption (2.7); purchases likewise daily at daily NAV in continuous public and private offerings.

Eligibility: one-year holding period (death/disability/key-person exceptions; DRIP shares exempt); minimum-balance forced repurchase provision exists; 2026-03-02 amendment waives the one-year hold for certain non-U.S. feeder vehicles. Funding: combination of operating cash flows, sales of real estate investments, borrowings and offering proceeds; line of credit may fund repurchases if requests exceed offering proceeds (with leverage-ratio consequences). 4.1.value: NAV FREQUENCY: DAILY - struck at the end of each day the NYSE is open; 'externally advised, daily valued perpetual life REIT' (the cohort's daily-NAV cadence contrast to BREIT/SREIT monthly). Calculation: performed by ALPS (ALPS Fund Services Inc.) effective 2018-01-01 under board-adopted valuation guidelines; Advisor reviews/confirms and oversees. Property valuation: each wholly owned property appraised QUARTERLY under an annual valuation plan managed by independent valuation advisor SitusAMC (4.3); new acquisitions at cost then join the cycle; income-approach DCF is the primary methodology (Topic 820). Daily NAV accrues budgeted portfolio income/expenses, advisory fees, servicing fees; adjustments to actuals applied prospectively ('We do not retroactively adjust the NAV per share of each class for each day'). Caveats printed: 'Our valuation procedures and our NAV are not subject to GAAP or independent audit'; mortgages/company debt valued at COST in NAV; zero-floor rule for underwater property/mortgage pairs.

6.1.value: Maryland corporation (inc. 2004-05-28), externally advised daily-valued perpetual-life REIT (REIT-taxed since 2004). UPREIT: substantially all assets held through JLLIPT Holdings, LP (Delaware; the 'operating partnership'); sole GP is wholly owned JLLIPT Holdings GP, LLC; Company owned 71.5% of OP Units at 2025-12-31 (28.5% third parties; OP Unit issuance proceeds $1,097,417K). Advisor: LaSalle Investment Management, Inc.; Sponsor: JLL (NYSE: JLL). NINE share classes (A, M, A-I, M-I, D, I, N, S, Z) across: Fourth Extended Public Offering (from 2025-06-06, up to $1,500,000K), Class N Private Offering (from 2015-03-03; $98,188K raised), Continuous Private Offering of D/I/S/Z (from 2025-10-07; printed 'aggregate gross proceeds of $6,696,000' - NOTE units inconsistent in filing: surrounding Item 1 amounts are in thousands, but FY2025 share issuances of 272,469 Class I + 317,022 Class S shares at ~$11.3 NAV imply the figure is whole dollars, i.e. ~$6,696K), DRIP. DST Program (from 2019-10-16, cap raised to $3,000,000K on 2024-08-06; ~$2,300,000K raised): 1031-exchange private placements of Delaware statutory trust interests with FMV Option to acquire back into the OP; DST financing obligations at fair value $1,174,938K. Portfolio: interests in 140 properties + 2,440 single-family rental homes in 27 states at 2025-12-31.

6.2.value: Core diversified US direct real estate: 'well-located, well-leased properties within the healthcare, industrial, residential, retail and other sectors' plus, to a lesser degree, real-estate-related assets (mortgage loans, RE debt/equity securities). Objectives as printed: attractive current income, preserve/protect capital, NAV appreciation over time, enable real estate as an asset class in diversified portfolios. Complexity LOW-MODERATE for the cohort: direct property ownership (no fund-of-funds layer), a few JVs and unconsolidated affiliates, DST syndication program with FMV repurchase option, interest-rate derivatives (rate cap, $8,225K premium FY2025), target leverage 30-50% (32% actual); international investments contemplated only 'over time'. Sector mix at 2025-12-31 by fair value: Industrial 40%, Residential 37%, Retail 12%, Healthcare 11%.
